heard: Jupiter was once twice as wide as it is today. That ancient monster could have swallowed 8,000 Earths. Even now, every other planet fits inside it twice over. Its gravity was so strong, it sculpted our entire solar system. Jupiter rotates so fast, a full day lasts 10 hours. The speed feeds a storm bigger than the Earth itself. The volcanic moon Io is being stretched by that massive pull. But modern Jupiter is just a remnant of that former self. The gas giant was once twice as wide.
